reasoning.title: Exhaustive literal review matching
reasoning.description: Use when a shopping task asks which reviewers mention a phrase or concept; do not use semantic relevance to exclude a visible textual match unless the task explicitly requires a particular referent.
reasoning.content: Open the product’s “Reviews” tab, read every review across all “Page”/“Next” links, and include every tied or qualifying row—even if the wording appears to refer to an adjacent detail rather than the expected product feature. Copy each reviewer’s full visible “Review by” value, using another page or detail view to resolve duplicated or abbreviated display text, and verify every answer directly on the page rather than guessing or conflating similar variants.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive paginated review scan
reasoning.description: Use when a shopping task asks which reviewers mention a phrase or topic; do not rely on the review count link, summaries, or semantic interpretation alone when the requested wording may appear in an unexpected context.
reasoning.content: Open the product page’s “Reviews” tab, read every review body on every page using the “Page” or “Next” links, and record every row containing the literal wording or a clearly qualifying variant—even if its surrounding context seems unrelated to the intended topic. Verify each match visibly, pair it with the adjacent “Review by” value, deduplicate repeated reviews across pages, and use the clean full name from another page or detail view if the displayed name is concatenated or abbreviated.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive review scan with pagination and exact-name verification
reasoning.description: Use when a product-page task asks for every reviewer whose text mentions a term or concept; do not stop at the visible page or exclude literal matches based on a narrower interpretation of context.
reasoning.content: Open the “Reviews” tab, read every review title and body, and follow “Page Next” or numbered page links until no further page exists, while accounting for reviews duplicated across pages. Include every visibly qualifying row—including broad or literal mentions—then copy the full “Review by” value; if a name appears concatenated, abbreviated, or otherwise malformed, verify it on another page or detail view rather than guessing or silently omitting it.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive paginated review matching
reasoning.description: Use when a shopping-product task asks which reviewers mention a word, phrase, or concept; do not use unrelated search or review-submission controls as substitutes for reading the product’s reviews.
reasoning.content: Open the product’s “Reviews” tab or review-count link, then inspect every review card on every page via the labeled “Page” or “Next” links, including repeated boundary rows. Record every row containing the requested wording or a clear equivalent without narrowing it by an assumed referent, verify the match in the visible review text, and copy the reviewer’s complete displayed name; if a list view duplicates, truncates, or abbreviates it, confirm it on another page or in the detail view before deduplicating.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive paginated review scan with name normalization
reasoning.description: Use for product-page questions asking which reviewers mention a phrase or concept; not for catalog attribute searches, because the site’s Search and Advanced Search controls find products rather than filter review text.
reasoning.content: Open the visible “Reviews” tab, read every review title and body, and follow every “Page”/“Next” link; include every visibly qualifying row, including close wording, without silently narrowing the requested criterion. Copy the full “Review by” value, opening another page or detail view when needed, and normalize obvious adjacent duplicate renderings only after confirming the same reviewer appears cleanly elsewhere; distinguish true near-identical names and verify the final list against all pages.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive review-phrase scan
reasoning.description: Use when a shopping task asks which reviewers mention a phrase or concept; do not use catalog Search or Advanced Search as a substitute for inspecting product reviews, because those controls search products rather than filter review text.
reasoning.content: On the product page, open the “Reviews” tab, read every review body and title, and follow every “Page” or “Next” link until no review pages remain. Treat any visible wording that literally matches the requested terms as qualifying even if its context seems unrelated, enumerate every qualifying byline, and verify names from the clearest displayed version or a detail view when text is abbreviated, duplicated, or has a near-identical variant.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive review-text matching
reasoning.description: Use when a shopping product task asks which reviewers mention a phrase or concept; do not use product details, ratings, or the review-submission form as substitutes for the customer-review list.
reasoning.content: Open the visible “Reviews” tab, read every review title and body, and follow each “Page”/“Next” link through the complete list, accounting for rows repeated across page boundaries. Include every row with a visible literal or close wording match even if the sentence’s context seems to concern another object; copy the full displayed “Review by” value, verify it on a cleaner page or detail view if duplicated or abbreviated, deduplicate exact repeats, and distinguish near-identical names rather than guessing.

reasoning.title: Exhaustive review pagination and canonical-name check
reasoning.description: Apply when identifying every reviewer whose title or review text semantically matches a requested topic; do not use this process for product facts outside customer reviews.
reasoning.content: Open the product page’s “Reviews” tab (the review-count link may only jump to it), inspect every review title and body, and follow every “Page Next” or numbered page until no pages remain; include all plausible wording variants rather than only exact phrases. For each qualifying row, copy the full visible “Review by” value, reconcile duplicated reviews across pages using the cleanest complete rendering or a detail view, and verify every final name against visible text before answering—never preserve an obvious concatenation artifact or omit a qualifying row.

reasoning.title: Scan all review pages and include every plausible text match
reasoning.description: Use when identifying reviewers whose review text mentions a requested feature or condition; do not use a narrow contextual interpretation when the site’s expected matching may be literal or phrase-based.
reasoning.content: Open the product’s visible “Reviews” tab, then use every numbered “Page” or “Next” control to inspect all review titles and bodies; a review-count link may only jump to the tab, not show the complete set. Include every visibly plausible wording match even if its immediate referent seems ambiguous, pair it with the adjacent full “Review by” value, deduplicate repeated rows and rendering artifacts, and verify abbreviated, concatenated, or near-identical names in a cleaner page or detail view before returning every qualifying reviewer.
